entry.author: Ministry of Health - Manatū Hauora
entry.summary:
Jacki Morris talks about the journey she has faced learning that her son Matthew is affected by Foetal anti-convulsant syndrome (FACS). Jacki talks about the importance of speaking to your medical professional and understanding your medicines, especially if you are pregnant or planning to get pregnant.

Read more about FACS on the Healthify website:  healthify.nz/facs

Find out more on the Ministry of Health website: https://www.health.govt.nz/news/ministry-of-health-working-with-facsnz-to-raise-awareness-of-foetal-anticonvulsant-syndrome
